content: For individuals with diabetes who are 40 years of age or older and do not have a history of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), the American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of moderate-intensity statin therapy as a primary prevention strategy. Clinical evidence demonstrates that this approach is effective in reducing the incidence of ASCVD events in this population. The benefits of moderate-intensity statin therapy have been observed across various subgroups, including those with differing levels of cardiovascular risk factors.
